description: This file defines two async functions, getOAuthApiKey and refreshOpenAICodexToken, which wrap external OAuth token management functions with additional environment setup calls. It acts as a runtime provider for OpenAI Codex API authentication tokens, relying on functions imported from a specific Pi-AI oauth library and a plugin SDK.

methods.name: export async function getOAuthApiKey( getOAuthApiKey
methods.description: Asynchronously retrieves OAuth API key by calling an imported function after ensuring environment setup.

methods.name: export async function refreshOpenAICodexToken( refreshOpenAICodexToken
methods.description: Asynchronously refreshes the OpenAI Codex token by calling an imported function after ensuring environment setup.
